headings.instructions: Use Manrope for all headings to provide a clean, modern SaaS look. Ensure tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for h1/h2.

body.instructions: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, form inputs, labels, and tables. Prioritize high readability and clarity.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use shadow-sm for cards. hover:shadow-md for interactive elements to provide subtle depth without visual clutter.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid var(--border). Soft, clean lines. Avoid heavy borders to keep the minimalist visual.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-lg (8px) for containers, cards, and inputs. rounded-full for avatars and badges.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid white backgrounds for cards to stand out on the slate-50 background. Avoid glassmorphism to maintain a professional, data-heavy SaaS feel.

component_name.Button: Use primary orange for main CTAs (e.g., 'Criar Pedido'). Use outline/ghost variants for secondary actions.
component_name.Badge: Order status badges MUST use distinct colors: 'Novo' (blue), 'Em preparo' (orange), 'Pronto' (green), 'Entregue' (slate), 'Cancelado' (red).
component_name.Card: Use for metric summaries and order tickets. Maintain minimal padding (p-4 or p-6) with clear internal hierarchy.
component_name.Table: Dense spacing for rows. Left-align text, right-align numbers and prices. Use for Products, Clients, and History.
component_name.Input/Select: Clean borders, subtle focus ring (focus:ring-primary). Fast keyboard navigation.
component_name.Toast: Use 'sonner' for notifications (Order created, status updated).

grids.dashboard: Use high density grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 for top metrics. grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 for active orders layout.
grids.orders_board: Grid layout for active orders to quickly scan statuses (e.g. Kanban style columns or dense list view).

layouts.app_shell: Sidebar navigation (fixed left, w-64, clear separation via border-r) + Top header (user profile, search/actions) + Main scrollable content area.
layouts.page_header: Flex row, justify-between, items-center. Left: Page Title (h1). Right: Primary actions (e.g., '+ Novo Pedido').

motion.transitions: Keep it highly functional. Use specific transitions: transition-colors duration-200 for buttons/hover states. As per user request: 'Sem excesso de animações'.
motion.micro_interactions: Subtle scale change (scale-98) on button click. No heavy or decorative parallax.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary orange text on white bg meets minimum contrast. White text on primary orange is accessible.
accessibility.focus: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-orders-link', data-testid='create-order-button').

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all iconography (Menu, Home, ShoppingCart, Users, Package, Clock, CheckCircle).
media.images: Minimal images. Professional B2B layout prioritizes typography and data. Use UI avatars for users.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update index.css to use the provided CSS variables for the warm amber/orange SaaS theme.
Remove default App.css center alignment if any.
Implement Sidebar + Header layout. Ensure it's responsive (hamburger menu on mobile).
Use Manrope font for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Add these to index.html or import them in CSS.
Build the Dashboard, Order Creation (with calculations), Order Details, Products, and Clients screens as specified.
Create realistic Portuguese (Brazil) mock data for orders, products, and clients.
Ensure the UI uses Portuguese (Brasil) for all labels, placeholders, and text.
Write components in .js or .jsx (not .tsx) as the project uses JavaScript.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight, while respecting the minimal B2B constraints requested.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements and clean grid systems.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs minimal but functional micro-animations - hover states, button presses.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
